title: Add programmatic flashlight Rerun example
objective: Implement a new examples/flashlight script that programmatically controls flashlight intensity/direction from a Python hook while streaming viewport-aligned RGB, depth, normals, albedo, camera trajectory, and light status to a live Rerun viewer.
instructions: Add examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py as a copy/new live example derived from the existing flashlight run.py and render_flythrough.py patterns.
Use the live spectator viewport camera as the source of truth each capture tick via rendering_service.get_current_viewport_desc(...), not a scripted flythrough route.

Expose programmatic control through a top-level LightCommand dataclass and compute_light_command(elapsed_seconds, frame_index, viewport_desc, previous_command) hook; default behavior should use CLI defaults and be easy for the user to edit.
Spawn a movable ASpotLight, apply enabled/intensity/yaw/pitch offsets each tick, and keep light position colocated with the live viewport camera.
Spawn BP_CameraSensor and capture final_tone_curve_hdr_, sp_depth_meters_, world_normal_, and diffuse_color_ at configurable width/height/capture-fps aligned to the viewport pose.
Integrate rerun as rr with live viewer spawn by default; publish images, depth, normals, albedo, camera pose/trajectory, and scalar/text status for intensity/direction/enabled.
Print a compact terminal status line per capture tick with frame index, camera world location/rotation, light enabled/intensity, and yaw/pitch offsets.
Add CLI options for map/map-path, movement speed, disable-scene-lights, light defaults, width, height, capture-fps, rerun-app-id, and no-rerun-spawn.
Add rerun-sdk==0.32.2 to the examples optional dependency group in python/pyproject.toml; keep core dependencies unchanged.
Handle missing rerun import with a clear install hint.
Clean up spawned light, camera sensor, camera components, and SPEAR instance on Ctrl+C/finally.
constraints: Do not update README or other docs; Tower will delegate docs to Scribe after implementation.
Stay within examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py and python/pyproject.toml unless a clearly necessary implementation support edit is discovered; report any deviation.
expected_outputs: New script path and dependency edit listed explicitly.
Verification commands run and results summarized.
definition_of_done: Script compiles with python syntax check.
Rerun dependency is in examples optional dependencies, not core dependencies.
ResultPacket names changed files and notes README follow-up needed.
